voices.name: Juanma - Deep Cinematic, Argentina
voices.description: Deep, resonant Argentine male narrator with a calm, cinematic authority. Slow, measured pacing and a warm low register: ideal for movie trailers, documentaries, storytelling, audiobooks and serious institutional messages.

voices.name: Angela - Warm, Clear and Professional
voices.description: Middle-aged American female voice. Warm, articulate and engaging. Perfect for instructional, medical, Scientific, and audiobook narration.
